ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (dark) pixels forming the base surface, with approximately 8-12% high-intensity (white) pixels localized in linear scars and distal barnacle clusters.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Uniform low-intensity pigmentation across >85% of surface; high-intensity circular clusters (barnacles) localized at lateral tips; dense network of high-intensity linear vectors (scars) distributed across both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch; interior angle approximately 45 degrees; vertical depth occupies ~20% of the lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous boundary exhibiting high-frequency, irregular pixel-amplitude variations; significant macro-indentations and tissue loss on the distal third of both lobes resulting in a jagged profile.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex upward trajectory from the medial notch to distal tips, terminating in sharp, upward-pointing lateral corners.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Densely packed high-intensity circular pixel clusters localized on the superior-lateral corners (distal tips); scattered circular anomalies visible on the interior ventral surfaces.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Extensive network of high-contrast, non-parallel linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) varying in orientation and length across the majority of the visible ventral area.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant irregular marginal tissue loss on distal tips; extensive white linear scarring (rake marks) present across both lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: Extremely high density of linear scarring; 'shredded' appearance of distal margins with heavy barnacle encrustation.
